function initGuestDashboardShortcuts(){
 const style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent=`
 #guest-calculator-drawer{position:fixed;inset:0 0 0 auto;margin:0;height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh;width:min(720px,100%);max-width:100%;border:0;padding:20px;overflow:auto;background:#f8fafc;color:#0f172a;box-shadow:-12px 0 40px #0f172a33}
 #guest-calculator-drawer[open]{animation:guest-drawer-in .2s ease-out}
 #guest-calculator-drawer::backdrop{background:rgb(15 23 42 / .65)}
 #guest-calculator-drawer button,#guest-calculator-drawer input,#guest-calculator-drawer select,#guest-calculator-open{min-height:48px}
 #guest-calculator-drawer input,#guest-calculator-drawer select{font-size:16px}
 #guest-calculator-drawer .guest-drawer-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
 #guest-calculator-close{padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:12px}
 #guest-calculator-open{margin-top:12px;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:#4f46e5;color:white;font-weight:700}
 .dark #guest-calculator-drawer{background:#0f172a;color:#f8fafc}
 @keyframes guest-drawer-in{from{transform:translateX(100%)}to{transform:translateX(0)}}
 @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#guest-calculator-drawer[open]{animation:none}}
 `;document.head.append(style);
 const drawer=document.createElement('dialog');drawer.id='guest-calculator-drawer';drawer.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','guest-calculator-heading');
 drawer.innerHTML='<div class="guest-drawer-header"><h2 id="guest-calculator-heading" class="font-bold text-lg">Future Paycheck Calculator</h2><button id="guest-calculator-close" type="button" aria-label="Close paycheck calculator">Close ✕</button></div><div id="guest-calculator-content"></div>';
 document.body.append(drawer);
 const source=$('view-calculator'),host=$('guest-calculator-content');let opener=null;
 function openCalculator(){if(drawer.open)return;opener=document.activeElement;while(source.firstChild)host.append(source.firstChild);drawer.showModal();calcPreview();$('calc-source-name').focus()}
 drawer.addEventListener('close',()=>{while(host.firstChild)source.append(host.firstChild);const target=opener?.isConnected?opener:$('guest-calculator-open');target?.focus()});
 $('guest-calculator-close').addEventListener('click',()=>drawer.close());
 $('form-paycheck-calc').addEventListener('submit',()=>{const count=state.paychecks.length;queueMicrotask(()=>{if(drawer.open&&state.paychecks.length>count)drawer.close()})},true);

 const activityCard=$('activity-log')?.closest('.glass');
 if(activityCard){
  const activityStyle=document.createElement('style');activityStyle.textContent=`
   #guest-activity-tab{position:fixed;right:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:90;writing-mode:vertical-rl;min-width:44px;padding:18px 12px;border:1px solid #c7d2fe;border-radius:14px 0 0 14px;background:#4338ca;color:white;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 3px 14px #0f172a33;touch-action:manipulation}
   #guest-activity-tab:focus-visible,#guest-activity-close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #60a5fa;outline-offset:3px}
   #guest-activity-drawer{position:fixed;inset:0 0 0 auto;margin:0;width:min(440px,100%);max-width:100%;height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh;border:0;padding:20px;overflow:auto;background:#f8fafc;color:#0f172a;box-shadow:-12px 0 40px #0f172a33}
   #guest-activity-drawer[open]{animation:guest-drawer-in .2s ease-out}
   #guest-activity-drawer::backdrop{background:rgb(15 23 42 / .65)}
   #guest-activity-drawer button{min-height:48px;padding:10px 16px}
   #guest-activity-close{border:1px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:12px}
   #guest-activity-drawer #activity-log{max-height:none;overflow:visible}
   .dark #guest-activity-drawer{background:#0f172a;color:#f8fafc}
   @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#guest-activity-drawer[open]{animation:none}}
  `;document.head.append(activityStyle);
  const tab=document.createElement('button');tab.type='button';tab.id='guest-activity-tab';tab.innerHTML='<i class="fa-solid fa-clock-rotate-left text-slate-500" aria-hidden="true" style="color:inherit;margin-bottom:8px"></i><span>Recent Activity</span>';tab.setAttribute('aria-haspopup','dialog');tab.setAttribute('aria-controls','guest-activity-drawer');tab.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  const panel=document.createElement('dialog');panel.id='guest-activity-drawer';panel.setAttribute('aria-labelledby','guest-activity-title');
  panel.innerHTML='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px"><h2 id="guest-activity-title" class="font-bold text-lg">Recent Activity</h2><button id="guest-activity-close" type="button" aria-label="Close recent activity">Close ✕</button></div>';
  const footer=activityCard.lastElementChild;if(footer?.querySelector('span'))footer.querySelector('span').textContent='Saved only in this browser.';
  panel.append(activityCard);document.body.append(tab,panel);
  tab.addEventListener('click',()=>{renderActivity();panel.showModal();tab.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true')});
  $('guest-activity-close').addEventListener('click',()=>panel.close());
  panel.addEventListener('close',()=>{tab.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');tab.focus()});
 }
 function update(){
  const safeLabel=$('fp2-safe')?.previousElementSibling;
  if(safeLabel&&!safeLabel.querySelector('[data-safe-spend-icon]')){
   const icon=document.createElement('img');icon.dataset.safeSpendIcon='';icon.alt='Safe to spend';icon.width=40;icon.height=40;icon.decoding='async';icon.style.cssText='display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:6px;width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain';
   icon.src='data:image/png;base64,';safeLabel.append(icon);
  }

  const balanceLabel=$('fp2-balance')?.previousElementSibling;
  if(balanceLabel&&!balanceLabel.querySelector('[data-balance-icon]')){
   const icon=document.createElement('img');icon.dataset.balanceIcon='';icon.alt='Bank balance';icon.width=40;icon.height=40;icon.decoding='async';icon.style.cssText='display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:6px;width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain';
   icon.src='data:image/png;base64,';balanceLabel.append(icon);
  }

  const section=$('guest-upcoming-paychecks');if(section&&!$('guest-calculator-open')){const button=document.createElement('button');button.id='guest-calculator-open';button.type='button';button.textContent='Open Future Paycheck Calculator';button.addEventListener('click',openCalculator);section.append(button)}
  const empty=$('guest-pay-list')?.querySelector('p');if(empty)empty.textContent='No upcoming paychecks. Add one here or open the calculator below.';
  const next=billsBetween(day(),plusMonths(day(),12)).find(o=>!isPaid(o));

  const progress=$('next-bill-progress');
  if(progress){
   const amount=Number(next?.bill.amount)||0;
   const balance=Number(effectiveBalance())||0;
   const deficit=next?Math.max(0,amount-balance):0;
   const track=progress.parentElement;
   track.style.backgroundColor=deficit>0?'#dc2626':'';
   let note=$('next-bill-deficit');
   if(!note){note=document.createElement('div');note.id='next-bill-deficit';note.style.cssText='color:#dc2626;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-align:right;margin-top:4px';note.setAttribute('aria-live','polite');track.after(note)}
   note.hidden=deficit<=0;
   note.textContent=deficit>0?'-'+money(deficit):'';
   note.setAttribute('aria-label',deficit>0?'Balance shortfall: '+money(deficit):'');
  }
  const label=$('fp2-next')?.previousElementSibling;
  if(label){label.querySelector('[data-next-bill-icon]')?.remove();if(next){const icon=guestBillIcon(next.bill),badge=document.createElement('span');badge.dataset.nextBillIcon='';badge.textContent=icon[1]+' ';badge.setAttribute('role','img');badge.setAttribute('aria-label',icon[2]);label.querySelector('strong')?.prepend(badge)}}
  const pay=state.paychecks.filter(p=>p.status!=='received'&&p.date>=day()).sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date))[0];
  const payLabel=$('fp2-pay')?.previousElementSibling;
  if(payLabel){
   payLabel.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode('Next Paycheck'+(pay?': ':'')));
   payLabel.style.removeProperty('color');
   if(pay){
    const icon=document.createElement('img');icon.alt='Paycheck received';icon.style.cssText='display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;margin:0 5px;width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain';
    icon.src='data:image/png;base64,';icon.width=40;icon.height=40;icon.decoding='async';
    const name=document.createElement('strong');name.textContent=pay.name||'Unnamed job';name.style.color='#166534';payLabel.append(name,icon);
   }
  }

 }
 const oldRender=render;render=function(...args){const result=oldRender(...args);update();return result};update();
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',initGuestDashboardShortcuts,{once:true});else initGuestDashboardShortcuts();
